summary: Phase-2 (Featured/Lead pricing, Agent subscription tiers, Verification system, Saved-search alerts, Locality Compare, EMI, AI-InfraValue) tested end-to-end. Backend: 20/20 pytest tests passed covering GET /promote/plans (3 plans), POST /properties/{pid}/promote (plan-14 marks featured + tier=spotlight), POST /properties/{pid}/leads for wa/call/visit at ₹25/35/75 slabs, admin GET /properties/{pid}/leads with total_cost rollup + 403 on wrong token, GET /properties returns featured-first with seeded IDs present, POST /properties/{pid}/verification-request + admin approve flips property.verified=true, GET /agent-subscription-tiers returns Gold/Silver/Bronze/Unverified with perks, GET /agents/{aid}/analytics returns tier+metrics+trend_14d (14 entries), saved-searches CRUD+matches, GET /compare/localities returns 2 enriched rows with lifestyle+properties_count+featured_count, POST /finance/emi returns emi+4 bank_offers+eligibility note, and GET /properties/p-02/ai-valuation returns fair_value_low/high+confidence+key_factors+risks (cached <5s on 2nd call). Frontend (mobile 390x844): /subscriptions renders Buyers+Agents tabs; Agents tab shows Bronze/Silver/Gold cards + monthly/annual toggle; /property/p-02 renders 'AI InfraValue' section + EMI pills (emi-down-20, emi-years-20, emi-income); /locality/loc-jagatpura has 'compare-localities-btn' that opens /compare-localities?ids= rendering side-by-side rows with 11 'Best' badges across criteria for 2 localities; /saved-searches lists created searches with create-search-btn; /promote-listing?pid=p-10 renders all 3 plans + UPI/Card radios + 'Pay & go live' which fires POST promote → success toast; /verify-listing?pid=p-15 renders doc-type chips + upload button + note input + submit; /admin-verification unlocks with token 'infrajagat-admin', lists pending requests, approve/reject buttons work (end-to-end verification request → approve verified via UI); /profile shows menu-saved-searches + menu-admin-verification + menu-subscriptions entries. Featured gold-border + 'Featured' badge rendered on 6 property cards on explore. Owner-only Promote/Verify buttons correctly hidden on p-02 (test user not owner).

issues: 'Save & alert me' chip sits beyond the horizontal viewport at 390px (after All/Apartments/Villas/Plots/Heat); user must scroll chips row horizontally to see it. testID present in DOM (verified via code at explore.tsx:222) but not visible without scroll. Consider making it the leading chip or using a visually distinct pill at the end of the filter row with a trailing indicator.

action_items: (Optional UX) Promote 'Save & alert me' chip to be always visible on /explore — place it before Heat or render as a sticky right-pinned chip (currently requires horizontal scroll on 390px viewports).
(Optional) Migrate deprecated shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents style props to the modern API to silence web console warnings (purely web-side).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (~1884 LOC) is approaching the 700-line split threshold — consider splitting Phase-2 endpoints (promote/leads/verification/subscriptions/saved-searches/compare/emi/ai-valuation) into feature modules.
ai-valuation caching uses `replace_one({property_id: pid}, …, upsert=True)` — this is correct. Mongo _id is excluded via NO_ID projection on read; new upsert docs don't echo _id back.
promote_property has sensible plan ID set ['plan-7','plan-14','plan-30']; test used wrong ID initially, fixed in /app/backend/tests/test_phase2_features.py.
owner_user_id gating on property/[id].tsx correctly hides Promote/Verify when the viewing user isn't the lister — validated during UI test (test user did not see owner tools on p-02).

admin review flow via POST /verification-requests/{vid}/review?decision=approve correctly flips property.verified=true and verification_status='Verified'; validated by GET /properties/p-07 returning verified:true after approval.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all listed features present + reachable; one minor UX note about chip overflow)
